author: ALWEvans
body: Please unban me, i plead not guilty. During the minutes before I was banned my computer was running smoothly. Everything was going well, a normal fps rate, but i'm not someone who normally has the best of things. The only device that i use to play  Minecraft is my labtop, and it sucks, but recently it has gotten better as Minecraft began to update. So everything was running smoothly until all of a sudden, i'm kicked. I was devastated because Avicus was the only server that i really enjoyed, the only server that I would go on. Now don't get me wrong, i have been banned before, but never for hacking or using any type of mod. I've seen others who have, but what's that point in having an advantage that makes you OP, then playing for fun and being good at something because of skill and practice.I Love playing on the Nexus especially when it comes to playing Nebula, just spectating makes me excited. To make this short, i'm sorry. It was my labtop,I promise. Please let me play on your server again, I miss it so much, it has been so long. ;_;
